title: Surface rate-limit headers on the public API
author: schen
description: Clients have no way to see how much quota they have left, so they back off blindly on the first 429. Emit the standard rate-limit headers on every public API response.
acceptance_criteria: Every public API response carries X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining
A throttled response also carries Retry-After in seconds
The change is covered by tests
